Claim 281 (Currently amended): A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer located on opposite sides of a medial section, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with each other; and an additional adhesive layer, wherein the additional adhesive layer is positioned in registration with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer.

Claim 282 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a composite material.

Claim 283 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section is a honeycomb structure.

Claim 284 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape.

Claim 290 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, wherein the tool further includes an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

Claim 291 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes a central opening.

Claim 293 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments.

Claim 294 (Currently amended): The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is continuous.
